name: io.github.tonyyang0504/autoria-mcp
description: AUTO.RIA (automotive): get_listing, get_valuation. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTORIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal API key from the developers.ria.com cabinet (Особистий кабінет); sent as the api_key query parameter. auto/info is freemium, statistic-avarage-price is paid.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTORIA_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your RIA user id (integer); required by get_valuation (auto/statistic-avarage-price takes user_id and api_key in the query).
